# HASK–HADocs Adapter Architecture

The adapter is isolated under `src/hadocs/knowledge/hask_pilot/`. `PilotConfig` is disabled by default; `loader` reads local JSON, negotiates version, validates required typed structure, checks per-file/aggregate SHA-256 and resolves references; `adapters` maps only bounded UniFi/MikroTik evidence and constructs candidate-only metadata; `runner` is explicit and has no normal-scan hook.

It imports no HASK modules, reads no YAML, downloads nothing, writes no cache, mutates no bundle and is not a singleton. Missing configuration is harmless while disabled and controlled when enabled.
